.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "Deduplicated GridPulse Real-Time event history by deterministic event_id, preferring the most complete physical delivery."
)
fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
{
    rt_price_event_history
    | extend completeness_score =
          iff(isnotempty(event_schema_version), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(event_type), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(event_id), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(observation_hash), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(delivery_date), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(delivery_hour), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(['interval']), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(zonal_price_capped_cad_per_mwh), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(loss_price_capped_cad_per_mwh), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(congestion_price_capped_cad_per_mwh), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(publication_state), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(source_name), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(source_file), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(source_url), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(source_hash), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(bronze_first_seen_at_utc), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(publisher_run_id), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotempty(poll_id), 1, 0)
        + iff(isnotnull(event_created_at_utc), 1, 0)
    | summarize arg_max(completeness_score, *) by event_id
    | project-away completeness_score
}

.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "Current eligible GridPulse Real-Time price state by native business key."
)
fn_rt_price_current()
{
    fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
    | summarize arg_max(event_created_at_utc, *) by
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        ['interval']
    | where publication_state == "ELIGIBLE"
}

let test_events =
    datatable(
        event_id:string,
        delivery_date:string,
        delivery_hour:int,
        interval_no:int,
        publication_state:string,
        event_created_at_utc:datetime
    )
    [
        "test-v1", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "ELIGIBLE",    datetime(2099-01-01T00:00:00Z),
        "test-v2", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "ELIGIBLE",    datetime(2099-01-01T00:05:00Z),
        "test-v3", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "INVALIDATED", datetime(2099-01-01T00:10:00Z)
    ];

let state_before_invalidation =
    test_events
    | where event_id != "test-v3"
    | summarize arg_max(event_created_at_utc, *) by
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no
    | where publication_state == "ELIGIBLE";

let state_after_invalidation =
    test_events
    | summarize arg_max(event_created_at_utc, *) by
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no
    | where publication_state == "ELIGIBLE";

union
(
    datatable(
        event_id:string,
        delivery_date:string,
        delivery_hour:int,
        interval_no:int,
        publication_state:string,
        event_created_at_utc:datetime
    )
    [
        "test-v1", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "ELIGIBLE", datetime(2099-01-01T00:00:00Z),
        "test-v2", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "ELIGIBLE", datetime(2099-01-01T00:05:00Z)
    ]
    | summarize arg_max(event_created_at_utc, *) by
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no
    | where publication_state == "ELIGIBLE"
    | project
        scenario = "after_revision_before_invalidation",
        current_event_id = event_id,
        publication_state
),
(
    datatable(
        event_id:string,
        delivery_date:string,
        delivery_hour:int,
        interval_no:int,
        publication_state:string,
        event_created_at_utc:datetime
    )
    [
        "test-v1", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "ELIGIBLE", datetime(2099-01-01T00:00:00Z),
        "test-v2", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "ELIGIBLE", datetime(2099-01-01T00:05:00Z),
        "test-v3", "2099-01-01", 1, 1, "INVALIDATED", datetime(2099-01-01T00:10:00Z)
    ]
    | summarize arg_max(event_created_at_utc, *) by
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no
    | where publication_state == "ELIGIBLE"
    | project
        scenario = "after_invalidation",
        current_event_id = event_id,
        publication_state
)
| order by scenario asc

union
(
    rt_price_event_history
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend metric = "physical_rows"
),
(
    fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend metric = "logical_events"
),
(
    rt_price_event_history
    | summarize physical_count = count() by event_id
    | where physical_count > 1
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend metric = "duplicate_event_ids"
),
(
    fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
    | where
        isempty(event_id)
        or isempty(event_type)
        or isempty(delivery_date)
        or isnull(delivery_hour)
        or isnull(['interval'])
        or isempty(source_hash)
        or isnull(event_created_at_utc)
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend metric = "logical_rows_missing_core_fields"
),
(
    fn_rt_price_current()
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend metric = "current_eligible_rows"
)
| project metric, value
| order by metric asc

fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
| summarize arg_max(event_created_at_utc, *) by
    delivery_date,
    delivery_hour,
    ['interval']
| summarize
    latest_business_keys = count(),
    latest_eligible = countif(publication_state == "ELIGIBLE"),
    latest_invalidated = countif(publication_state == "INVALIDATED")

.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "Gap-aware interval-over-interval GridPulse Real-Time price change over current eligible state."
)
fn_rt_price_change()
{
    fn_rt_price_current()
    | extend market_day_index = datetime_diff(
        "day",
        todatetime(delivery_date),
        datetime(1970-01-01)
    )
    | extend market_slot_ordinal =
          tolong(market_day_index) * 288
        + tolong(delivery_hour - 1) * 12
        + tolong(['interval'] - 1)
    | extend price =
        todouble(zonal_price_capped_cad_per_mwh)
    | order by market_slot_ordinal asc
    | serialize
    | extend
        previous_slot = prev(market_slot_ordinal),
        previous_price = prev(price)
    | extend slot_gap =
        iff(
            isnull(previous_slot),
            long(null),
            market_slot_ordinal - previous_slot
        )
    | extend interval_price_change =
        iff(
            slot_gap == 1,
            price - previous_price,
            real(null)
        )
    | extend is_negative_price =
        price < 0
    | project
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no = ['interval'],
        price,
        previous_price,
        slot_gap,
        interval_price_change,
        is_negative_price,
        event_id,
        source_hash,
        event_created_at_utc
}

fn_rt_price_change()

.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "Gap-aware rolling 15/30/60 minute GridPulse Real-Time price metrics over current eligible state."
)
fn_rt_price_rolling()
{
    let base = materialize(
        fn_rt_price_current()
        | extend market_day_index = datetime_diff(
            "day",
            todatetime(delivery_date),
            datetime(1970-01-01)
        )
        | extend market_slot_ordinal =
              tolong(market_day_index) * 288
            + tolong(delivery_hour - 1) * 12
            + tolong(['interval'] - 1)
        | project
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no = ['interval'],
            market_slot_ordinal,
            price = todouble(zonal_price_capped_cad_per_mwh),
            event_id,
            source_hash,
            event_created_at_utc
    );
    let window_specs = datatable(
        window_minutes:int,
        expected_slots:int
    )
    [
        15, 3,
        30, 6,
        60, 12
    ];
    base
    | extend join_key = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        window_specs
        | extend join_key = 1
    ) on join_key
    | project-away join_key, join_key1
    | extend offset = range(0, expected_slots - 1, 1)
    | mv-expand offset to typeof(long)
    | extend expected_slot =
        market_slot_ordinal - offset
    | join kind=leftouter (
        base
        | project
            expected_slot = market_slot_ordinal,
            matched_price = price
    ) on expected_slot
    | summarize
        matched_slots = countif(isnotnull(matched_price)),
        raw_avg = avg(matched_price),
        raw_min = min(matched_price),
        raw_max = max(matched_price),
        raw_stddev = stdev(matched_price)
        by
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no,
            market_slot_ordinal,
            window_minutes,
            expected_slots,
            event_id,
            source_hash,
            event_created_at_utc
    | extend window_complete =
        matched_slots == expected_slots
    | extend
        rolling_avg = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_avg,
            real(null)
        ),
        rolling_min = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_min,
            real(null)
        ),
        rolling_max = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_max,
            real(null)
        ),
        rolling_stddev = iff(
            window_complete,
            raw_stddev,
            real(null)
        )
    | project
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no,
        window_minutes,
        expected_slots,
        matched_slots,
        window_complete,
        rolling_avg,
        rolling_min,
        rolling_max,
        rolling_stddev,
        event_id,
        source_hash,
        event_created_at_utc
}

fn_rt_price_rolling()
{
    let base = materialize(
        fn_rt_price_current()
        | extend market_day_index = datetime_diff(
            "day",
            todatetime(delivery_date),
            datetime(1970-01-01)
        )
        | extend market_slot_ordinal =

        | project

            delivery_hour,
            interval_no = ['interval'],
            market_slot_ordinal,
            price = todouble(zonal_price_capped_cad_per_mwh),
            event_id,
            source_hash,
            event_created_at_utc
    );
    let window_specs = datatable(
        window_minutes:int,
        expected_slots:int
    )
    [
        15, 3,
        30, 6,
        60, 12
    ];
    base
    | extend join_key = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        window_specs
        | extend join_key = 1
    ) on join_key
    | project-away join_key, join_key1
    | extend offset = range(0, expected_slots - 1, 1)
    | mv-expand offset to typeof(long)
    | extend expected_slot =
        market_slot_ordinal - offset
    | join kind=leftouter (
        base
        | project
            expected_slot = market_slot_ordinal,

        raw_stddev = stdev(matched_price),

            market_slot_ordinal,
            window_minutes,
            expected_slots,

.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "Consolidated GridPulse Real-Time price serving metrics."
)
fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
{
    let r15 =
        fn_rt_price_rolling()
        | where window_minutes == 15
        | project
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no,
            rolling_15_complete = window_complete,
            rolling_15_avg = rolling_avg,
            rolling_15_min = rolling_min,
            rolling_15_max = rolling_max,
            rolling_15_stddev = rolling_stddev,
            negative_15_count = negative_price_count,
            negative_15_share = negative_price_share;
    let r30 =
        fn_rt_price_rolling()
        | where window_minutes == 30
        | project
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no,
            rolling_30_complete = window_complete,
            rolling_30_avg = rolling_avg,
            rolling_30_min = rolling_min,
            rolling_30_max = rolling_max,
            rolling_30_stddev = rolling_stddev,
            negative_30_count = negative_price_count,
            negative_30_share = negative_price_share;
    let r60 =
        fn_rt_price_rolling()
        | where window_minutes == 60
        | project
            delivery_date,
            delivery_hour,
            interval_no,
            rolling_60_complete = window_complete,
            rolling_60_avg = rolling_avg,
            rolling_60_min = rolling_min,
            rolling_60_max = rolling_max,
            rolling_60_stddev = rolling_stddev,
            negative_60_count = negative_price_count,
            negative_60_share = negative_price_share;
    fn_rt_price_change()
    | join kind=leftouter r15
        on delivery_date, delivery_hour, interval_no
    | join kind=leftouter r30
        on delivery_date, delivery_hour, interval_no
    | join kind=leftouter r60
        on delivery_date, delivery_hour, interval_no
    | project
        delivery_date,
        delivery_hour,
        interval_no,
        price,
        previous_price,
        slot_gap,
        interval_price_change,
        is_negative_price,
        rolling_15_complete,
        rolling_15_avg,
        rolling_15_min,
        rolling_15_max,
        rolling_15_stddev,
        negative_15_count,
        negative_15_share,
        rolling_30_complete,
        rolling_30_avg,
        rolling_30_min,
        rolling_30_max,
        rolling_30_stddev,
        negative_30_count,
        negative_30_share,
        rolling_60_complete,
        rolling_60_avg,
        rolling_60_min,
        rolling_60_max,
        rolling_60_stddev,
        negative_60_count,
        negative_60_share,
        event_id,
        source_hash,
        event_created_at_utc
}

.create-or-alter function
with (
    folder = "GridPulse/RealTime",
    docstring = "GridPulse Real-Time data-quality summary over physical and logical event state."
)
fn_rt_dq_summary()
{
    union
    (
        rt_price_event_history
        | summarize physical_count = count() by event_id
        | extend duplicate_rows = physical_count - 1
        | summarize metric_value = sum(duplicate_rows)
        | extend
            rule_id = "RT-DQ-001",
            rule_name = "Technical duplicate deliveries",
            severity = "WARN",
            status = iff(metric_value == 0, "PASS", "WARN")
        | project rule_id, rule_name, severity, status, metric_value
    ),
    (
        rt_price_event_history
        | where
            isempty(event_id)
            or isempty(event_type)
            or isempty(delivery_date)
            or isnull(delivery_hour)
            or isnull(['interval'])
            or isempty(source_hash)
            or isnull(event_created_at_utc)
        | summarize metric_value = count()
        | extend
            rule_id = "RT-DQ-002",
            rule_name = "Physical deliveries missing core fields",
            severity = "WARN",
            status = iff(metric_value == 0, "PASS", "WARN")
        | project rule_id, rule_name, severity, status, metric_value
    ),
    (
        fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
        | where
            isempty(event_id)
            or isempty(event_type)
            or isempty(delivery_date)
            or isnull(delivery_hour)
            or isnull(['interval'])
            or isempty(source_hash)
            or isnull(event_created_at_utc)
        | summarize metric_value = count()
        | extend
            rule_id = "RT-DQ-003",
            rule_name = "Logical events missing core fields",
            severity = "FAIL",
            status = iff(metric_value == 0, "PASS", "FAIL")
        | project rule_id, rule_name, severity, status, metric_value
    ),
    (
        fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
        | where not(
            (event_type == "RT_PRICE_OBSERVATION"
                and publication_state == "ELIGIBLE")
            or
            (event_type == "RT_PRICE_INVALIDATION"
                and publication_state == "INVALIDATED")
        )
        | summarize metric_value = count()
        | extend
            rule_id = "RT-DQ-004",
            rule_name = "Invalid event type and publication-state combination",
            severity = "FAIL",
            status = iff(metric_value == 0, "PASS", "FAIL")
        | project rule_id, rule_name, severity, status, metric_value
    ),
    (
        fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
        | where
            event_type == "RT_PRICE_OBSERVATION"
            and (
                isnull(zonal_price_capped_cad_per_mwh)
                or isnull(loss_price_capped_cad_per_mwh)
                or isnull(congestion_price_capped_cad_per_mwh)
            )
        | summarize metric_value = count()
        | extend
            rule_id = "RT-DQ-005",
            rule_name = "Published observations missing price components",
            severity = "FAIL",
            status = iff(metric_value == 0, "PASS", "FAIL")
        | project rule_id, rule_name, severity, status, metric_value
    ),
    (
        fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
        | where
            event_type == "RT_PRICE_INVALIDATION"
            and isempty(previous_event_id)
        | summarize metric_value = count()
        | extend
            rule_id = "RT-DQ-006",
            rule_name = "Invalidations missing previous event lineage",
            severity = "FAIL",
            status = iff(metric_value == 0, "PASS", "FAIL")
        | project rule_id, rule_name, severity, status, metric_value
    )
    | extend evaluated_at_utc = now()
    | order by rule_id asc
}

fn_rt_dq_summary()

union
(
    rt_price_event_history
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend
        check = "PHYSICAL_ROWS",
        source_hash = ""
    | project check, value, source_hash
),
(
    fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
    | summarize value = count()
    | extend
        check = "LOGICAL_EVENTS",
        source_hash = ""
    | project check, value, source_hash
),
(
    fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
    | summarize value = dcount(event_id)
    | extend
        check = "DISTINCT_EVENT_IDS",
        source_hash = ""
    | project check, value, source_hash
),
(
    fn_rt_price_event_dedup()
    | summarize value = count() by source_hash
    | extend check = "EVENTS_BY_SOURCE_HASH"
    | project check, value, source_hash
)
| order by check asc, value desc

fn_rt_dq_summary()
| order by rule_id asc
